source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: hasExtensionsInstalled counts successfully parsed active extensions that are not system, builtin or privileged. hasExperimentsInstalled adds the Experiment and not-allowlisted conditions. MailGlue refreshes these values on enable/disable as well as install/uninstall and startup. Experiment suppression remains a separate predicate and blocklist update. The existing install/uninstall test is not direct coverage of every added flag combination, and no telemetry result or callback race is inferred.
title: Extension status preferences count active non-special buckets and refresh on enable changes
